# Enjoy Properties

> San Antonio, TX real estate practice run by Tyler Ashbaugh, a licensed Texas REALTOR® (TREC Lic. #833862-SA) with Texas Premier Realty, LLC, and a software engineer of 22 years.

Enjoy Properties (enjoyproperties.us) helps buyers, sellers, renters, landlords, and real estate investors in San Antonio and the surrounding area. Tyler brings 22 years of software engineering rigor to real estate: clear numbers, honest projections, no hype.
